UiWidgetBundle.masterLabel: Mise à jour de la fiche client
UiWidgetBundle.description: Sample $attrs for the interactive Mise à jour de la fiche client (clientRecordUpdate) card — an editable KYC/contact confirm form (0.1.1 input tiles) modelled on the HXL gallery 'account-update-confirm'. Confirm gathers every field value at click time (inputs 'auto'); Cancel gathers none. select/radio options are {label,value} arrays; isChecked / value bind from attrs. Matches the client-record-update skill. A reference snapshot — illustrative values.
